links.outcome: Readability of AI responses (Flesch-Kincaid, Gunning Fog, SMOG, Flesch Reading Ease)
links.effect: Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level ranged 14.48 (Gemini) to 16.48 (Copilot); Gunning Fog 16.18 to 18.8; SMOG 16 to 17.54; Flesch Reading Ease low across all models (highest 21.3, Gemini).
links.quote: All responses showcased high complexity and difficult readability.

links.outcome: Concordance of AI answers with CNS Chiari guideline recommendations
links.effect: Concordance ranged from 23.1% (ChatGPT 4o) to 69.2% (Perplexity); Copilot 61.5%, Gemini 30.8%; non-concordant answers were mostly over-conclusive.
links.quote: Perplexity displayed the highest concordance rate of 69.2 %, with non-concordant responses classified as 0 % insufficient and 30.8 % over-conclusive.

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial LLMs on alignment with Chiari 1 malformation guidelines and readability metrics without testing any deployment safeguards or workflow practices.
